newsitem.title: USA: Affiliated Computer adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Affiliated Computer adopts rights plan.

text.p: Affiliated Computer Services Inc on Friday said it adopted a shareholder rights plan with a 15 percent trigger.
Under the plan, rights to purchase shares of the company's Class A common stock will be distributed as a dividend, one right per share, to owners of record as of August 25.
Affiliated Computer said the plan was not adopted in response to any known offers for the company.

Upon becoming exercisable, each right entitles holders to purchase a certain amount of common stock. The rights are not exercisable, however, until a person or group acquires more than 15 percent of common stock, announces a tender offer, or takes certain hostile actions specified in the plan, it said.
Affiliated Computer provides information technology services and electronic funds transfer processing.
